rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: First Federal's Renaissance
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, before 1978).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) in 1980 as 'First Federal's Renaissance'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. None to mild fragrance. 20 to 25 petals. Average diameter 6". Very large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
